arcs.title: The Table Awaits
arcs.summary: Day 3: They have departed. The Jeep left at six forty-one; the waymarker at the gorge mouth was logged at seven fifty-two; the ridge fog cleared by eight. The table is empty; the household is in Lucy's capable and unaccountable hands. Day 4 — the final day — should bring them home: the Jeep returns with mud on the wheels, something new on the map (a second circle, a note, a name), and whatever the table hosts next. The arc should resolve warmly with the return itself — the Jeep in the drive, the dogs at the door, Steve with something to say about the trail, Christine with something already planned for Monday. Resolution should feel like a satisfying exhale.
